summary: The audit checks six courses of at least 3 units each, all letter graded with a C or better: two BIO 80-series BioFoundations courses and four more from BIO courses numbered 100 and above (not the capstone, research or directed reading courses), the approved out-of-department list, or one more BIO 80-series course. BIOE 450 counts only once. At least three must be numbered 100 or above. You check the 2.0 GPA by hand.
